items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: mostly like with the tour we played for B.B. King

ctx.x: And who was in your group at that time?

I had a fellow by the name of -- I had guys from Newark. I had Chink Williams [phonetic sp.] on drums, Larry Gowan [phonetic sp.] at the bass, [indiscernible] King [phonetic sp.] played piano with me.
